LIC Jeevan Anand vs Jeevan Lakshya: Which is Better in 2026?

2026-06-11T10:00:00.000Z By Hari Kotian

LIC Jeevan Anand vs Jeevan Lakshya 2026

Jeevan Anand

- Whole life coverage (up to age 100)

- Death benefit: Sum assured + bonuses

- Maturity benefit at age 100

- Best for long-term wealth + protection

- Entry age: 18-50 years

Jeevan Lakshya

- Fixed term (13-25 years)

- Annual income benefit: 10% of sum assured paid yearly until maturity

- Premium waiver on death

- Best for family income protection

- Entry age: 18-50 years

Head-to-Head

| Feature | Jeevan Anand | Jeevan Lakshya |

|---|---|---|

| Coverage | Whole life | Fixed term |

| Death Benefit | Sum assured + bonuses | Sum assured + bonuses + annual income |

| Premium Waiver | No | Yes |

| Best For | Long-term wealth | Family income protection |

Premium Comparison (35-year-old, Rs. 10 lakh, 20-year term)

- Jeevan Anand: Rs. 48,000 - 52,000/year

- Jeevan Lakshya: Rs. 45,000 - 50,000/year
